lines.en: label yukidate10:
I tap on Yuki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Yuki 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: I haven’t really spent any time with her since the Halloween party, and even then, I don’t know if what I did would really count as {i}spending time with her{/i} to begin with.
lines.zh: 万圣节派对之后，我就基本没再跟她相处过，而且就算那次，我也不知道自己做的事到底算不算「{i}和她相处{/i}」。

lines.en: I just kind of showed up, revealed her long-lost and no longer comatose niece to her, and then went on my way.
lines.zh: 我就是露了个面，把她那个失散多年、也不再昏迷的侄女推到她面前，然后就走了。

lines.en: But I guess that’s just how things go sometimes.
lines.zh: 不过我想，有时候事情就是这样。

lines.en: But hey, if anyone I know is able to roll with the punches, it’s probably Yuki.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我认识的人里要是有谁经受得住打击，那大概就是 Yuki。

lines.en: For all I know, she’s completely come to terms with that aspect of her life being flipped on its head- given that she spent years personally flipping everything else over on her own.
lines.zh: 说不定她已经完全接受了人生中被翻过来的这一面——毕竟她自己花了那么多年，亲手把其他一切都翻了个底朝天。

lines.en: scene black
: Yo. Sorry, but I can’t really talk right now.
lines.zh: : 哟。抱歉，不过我现在真说不了话。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...because I have a job now?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为我现在有工作了？

lines.en: : Can’t just fuckin’ eat noodles with you whenever you want anymore. Gotta pay bills and shit.
lines.zh: : 不能再你想什么时候就什么时候跟你他妈吃面了。得付账单什么的。

lines.en: : What kind of bills do you even have?
lines.zh: : 你能有什么账单？

lines.en: : The fuck is that supposed to mean? Same kinda bills everyone else has to pay. Water...gas-
lines.zh: : 你他妈这话什么意思？跟其他人要付的账单一样啊。水费……燃气——

lines.en: : I don’t know man, whatever comes in the mail. I can’t be bothered to keep track of all that shit.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，老兄，反正就是寄到信箱里的那些。我懒得去记这些破事。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking you were still living on the streets. No offense.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你还住街上呢。没有冒犯的意思。

lines.en: : How am I not supposed be offended by- wait, Kaori! I already went that way!
lines.zh: : 你要我怎么才不被冒犯——等等，Kaori！我已经往那边走过了！

lines.en: : You’re with Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你和 Kaori 在一起？

lines.en: : Hm? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 嗯？对啊。

lines.en: : Sara was tired of bein’ cold and shit so she sent the two of us out here to pass out fliers.
lines.zh: : Sara 受够了冷得要死什么的，就派我们俩出来发传单。

lines.en: : And where is {i}here{/i} exactly?
lines.zh: : 那「{i}这儿{/i}」到底是哪儿？

lines.en: : Urban district. Why? You gonna come help?
lines.zh: : 市区。怎么？你要来帮忙？

lines.en: : No. But I wouldn’t mind standing around and talking to you while you work.
lines.zh: : 不。不过我不介意在你干活的时候站着陪你聊天。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure that- wait. That actually might be a good idea.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我猜你——等等。这说不定还真是个好主意。

lines.en: : Boss lady seems dead set on the whole idea of me bringin’ in new customers by bein’ the closest thing all these girls can get to an actual dude now, but...well, you’re {i}actually{/i} a dude.
lines.zh: : 老板娘似乎铁了心要让我靠「成为这群女孩能接触到的最接近男人的存在」来拉新客人，不过……嗯，你可是{i}真的{/i}男人。

lines.en: : Could save me the effort of turning down a bunch of desperately horny women and actually getting rid of all these papers.
lines.zh: : 这样我就能省下拒绝一堆饥渴女人的力气，还能真的把这些纸发出去。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Yuki. I’m not really that great at turning down desperately horny women.
lines.zh: : 不好说啊，Yuki。我可不怎么擅长拒绝饥渴的女人。

lines.en: : Then maybe I can show you a thing or two.
lines.zh: : 那也许我能教你一两招。

lines.en: : Maybe {i}I{/i} can show {i}you{/i} a thing or-
lines.zh: : 也许{i}我{/i}能教{i}你{/i}一两——

lines.en: Yuki hangs up on me (Likely on accident) and I’m suddenly faced with the question of whether or not I want to go all the way across Kumon-mi just to see her and her no-longer estranged niece.
lines.zh: Yuki 挂了我电话（大概是手滑），而我突然要面对一个问题：我到底想不想横穿整个 Kumon-mi，就为了见她和她那个不再疏远的侄女。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and accept that, at this point, I’ve pretty much already decided.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气，承认自己到这一步其实已经做好了决定。

lines.en: It’s very rare that I make it this far into a conversation only to back out and, well...I guess it’s been getting a little warmer out lately anyway.
lines.zh: 我很少有都聊到这份上又反悔的时候，而且……嗯，最近天气也确实暖和了一点。

lines.en: A trip to the urban district might not actually be all that bad with that in mind.
lines.zh: 这么一想，跑一趟市区说不定也没那么糟。

lines.en: Besides, maybe Yuki and I can...bond over the fact that we...both have nieces or something.
lines.zh: 再说了，也许我和 Yuki 能……因为我们……都有侄女什么的而拉近关系。

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。

lines.en: I just need to keep myself occupied.
lines.zh: 我只是得让自己有点事做。

lines.en: Nothing good ever comes from wandering around aimlessly.
lines.zh: 漫无目的地乱逛从来不会有好结果。

lines.en: And if I can focus on something, I’m sure I’ll-
lines.zh: 只要我能把注意力集中在某件事上，我肯定就——

lines.en: scene beforewefall5
scene everythingg5
scene dust3
scene yukiflier1
Oh. Okay.
lines.zh: 哦。好吧。

lines.en: I guess I’m here now.
lines.zh: 看来我到了。

lines.en: : You fuckin’ run here or something? I feel like I just hung up on you like five minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是跑过来的吗？我明明感觉五分钟前才挂你电话。

lines.en: : I was just really excited to see you, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概只是太想见你了。

lines.en: scene yukiflier2
: Yeah? Lucky me.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我真走运。

lines.en: : Want a flier? I’ve only got like two hundred more to get rid of, and Sara didn’t say shit about not givin’ ‘em out to people who have already been to the bar.
lines.zh: : 要张传单吗？我还有大概两百张要发，而 Sara 可没说不能发给已经去过酒吧的人。

lines.en: : That’s great, because if you can give one to me and every other customer you’ve ever had, you’ll only have around 195 left.
lines.zh: : 好极了，因为如果你给我一张、再给你以前所有顾客各一张，你也就只剩大概 195 张了。

lines.en: scene yukiflier3
: Shit’s actually been pickin’ up lately, believe it or not.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，生意最近其实有起色。

lines.en: : Granted, I don’t really know how it was before I started goin’ there, but we’ve basically always got {i}somebody{/i} inside.
lines.zh: : 当然，我不知道我开始去之前是什么样，不过我们店里基本一直都{i}有人{/i}。

lines.en: That’s actually pretty surprising given how horrible the name of the place is.
lines.zh: 考虑到这店名字有多操蛋，这其实挺让人惊讶的。

lines.en: And the fact that Sara is confident enough in it to put it on a flier makes it all the more surprising that-
lines.zh: 而 Sara 居然有信心把名字印在传单上，这就更让人惊讶——

lines.en: : What? Somethin’ wrong with the flier?
lines.zh: : 怎么？传单有什么问题？

lines.en: : Apart from the name of the bar? Yeah.
lines.zh: : 除了酒吧的名字？有。

lines.en: : Did Sara design these?
lines.zh: : 这些是 Sara 设计的？

lines.en: scene yukiflier4
: Nope. She gave me complete creative control or whatever.
lines.zh: : 不是。她给了我完全的创作自由什么的。

lines.en: : Well...I’m glad that she trusts you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我很高兴她信任你。

lines.en: scene yukiflier5
: Wait, I didn’t spell anything wrong, did I?
lines.zh: : 等等，我没拼错什么字吧？

lines.en: : I ain’t really the best when it comes to writing and shit on account of the whole no education thing.
lines.zh: : 我这人写字什么的确实不太行，毕竟没受过什么教育。

lines.en: : No, it’s all fine. You just normally want to be a little more...polite or...precise when it comes to marketing, I think.
lines.zh: : 不，都挺好的。只是一般来说，做宣传时要更……礼貌一点，或者……更精确一点，我觉得。

lines.en: : And saying “You have drinks and shit” doesn’t really scream “You should come to this bar.”
lines.zh: : 而且写「我们有酒和别的东西」并不能真的让人觉得「你该来这家酒吧」。

lines.en: : All bars have drinks and shit. That’s the entire purpose of a bar.
lines.zh: : 所有酒吧都有酒和别的东西。那本来就是酒吧的全部意义。

lines.en: scene yukiflier6
: Well, what the fuck else do you want me to put on here? “Come to Sakaki-bar-a: We’ve got a horny barmaid and her reclusive daughter?”
lines.zh: : 那他妈你到底想让我印什么？「来 Sakaki-bar-a 吧：我们有一个发情的酒吧女侍和她那个宅女女儿？」

lines.en: : You joke, but that would bring me in quicker than the other sign.
lines.zh: : 你当玩笑说，可这比另一句更能把我招进来。

lines.en: scene yukiflier7
: Yeah, but you’re a fucking creep and normal people probably don’t think the same way as you.
lines.zh: : 是，可你是个操蛋的变态，正常人大概不会跟你一个想法。

lines.en: : You remind me more and more of your daughter every time I talk to you.
lines.zh: : 每次跟你说话，你都越来越像你女儿。

lines.en: scene yukiflier8
: Oh, speaking of which...were you able to give my present to Yumi?
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个……你把我的礼物给 Yumi 了吗？

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I guess I should have probably called you about that or something.
lines.zh: : 哦，给了。我大概应该打个电话跟你说一声什么的。

lines.en: : I gave it to her at the Halloween party, but I didn’t really stick around to see what she thought of it.
lines.zh: : 我在万圣节派对上给她了，不过我没留下来看她什么反应。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t even think I asked what it was you gave her.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我甚至不记得有问过你送了她什么。

lines.en: scene yukiflier9
: Nothing that impressive. Just a case for her phone and some gift cards and shit.
lines.zh: : 没什么了不起的。就是个手机壳，还有几张礼品卡什么的。

lines.en: : Figure that if you’re gonna be payin’ her phone bill, least I can do is get her something to protect it from breakin’ or...getting wet or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我想既然你要替她付电话费，我至少能做的就是买点东西，保护它别摔坏或者……弄湿什么的。

lines.en: : If she’s anything like me, she’ll break that shit quicker than you can cook a pot of rice.
lines.zh: : 要是她像我，你煮一锅米的功夫她就能把那玩意儿弄坏。

lines.en: : I’m going to ignore the irony of this analogy and just re-confirm that I did give Yumi the present.
lines.zh: : 我打算无视这个类比里的讽刺，只重新确认一遍——我确实把礼物给了 Yumi。

lines.en: : I am sure that whatever happened after that went entirely according to plan and that her phone is both dry and protected as we speak.
lines.zh: : 我确信之后发生的一切都完全按计划进行，而此刻她的手机既干燥又受到了保护。

lines.en: scene yukiflier10
: Heh. Look at us- both payin’ for her shit. It’s almost like I’m actually her mom again.
lines.zh: : 呵。看看我们——都在替她付账。搞得我好像又真的当上她妈了一样。

lines.en: : True, but that would make me her dad and I don’t think any of us would particularly enjoy that sort of change in our relationship status.
lines.zh: : 没错，可那我就成她爸了，我觉得我们谁都不会特别乐意关系状态变成那样。

lines.en: : Hey, can’t be any worse than her last dad. Unless you’re plannin’ on makin’ me suck you off in exchange for a bed or some shit.
lines.zh: : 嘿，总不会比她上一个爸更糟。除非你打算让我给你口，换张床睡什么的。

lines.en: : But I’m starting to think you’re not that type of guy.
lines.zh: : 不过我开始觉得你不是那种人。

lines.en: : I will continue working hard to prove to you that I’m not that type of person.
lines.zh: : 我会继续努力向你证明我不是那种人。

lines.en: : Unless you’re offering. In that case, you can sleep in my bed whenever you like.
lines.zh: : 除非你主动提出。那样的话，你什么时候想睡我的床都行。

lines.en: : Noted.
lines.zh: : 记下了。

lines.en: : Not going to use this opportunity to remind me that you’re too old for me or...not interested in that sort of thing, or whatever it is you always say?
lines.zh: : 不打算借这个机会提醒我你对我来说太老，或者……对这种事没兴趣，或者你总说的那些？

lines.en: scene yukiflier11
: Nah. You’ve heard that shit enough by now. No point in repeatin’ myself anymore.
lines.zh: : 不了。那些话你已经听够了。没必要再重复。

lines.en: : But hey, if any of that changes, I’ll make sure you’re the first to know.
lines.zh: : 不过嘿，要是哪天情况变了，我保证让你第一个知道。

lines.en: Did Yuki just openly admit that there’s actually a prospect of the two of us sleeping together eventually?
lines.zh: Yuki 刚刚是在公开承认，我们俩将来真的有可能上床吗？

lines.en: Because even if those doors stay closed forever, the fact that I’m the first in line outside of them means that, if I time everything well enough, I might be able to squeeze my way in at the first sight of an opening.
lines.zh: 因为就算那些门永远关着，我排在门外第一个这件事也意味着——只要时机掐得够好，一有缝我就能挤进去。

lines.en: I’ll mark this down as a victory and file it in a completely separate cabinet from the one where I keep the prospect of fucking her daughter.
lines.zh: 我会把这件事记作一场胜利，然后归档到我存放「操她女儿的可能性」那个柜子完全不同的另一个柜子里。

lines.en: Then, before I attempt to carry on the conversation like a normal human being, I chuckle to myself at the idea of a cabinet full of written documents full of different girls’ sexual characteristics and traits.
lines.zh: 然后，在我试图像正常人一样继续对话之前，我暗自笑了起来——想象着一柜子写满不同女孩性征与癖好的文件。

lines.en: I wonder how many more loops it will take before Maya is forced to forge something like that instead of just her weird journal of my {i}original{/i} ten students.
lines.zh: 我好奇还要再绕多少个弯，Maya 才会被迫去伪造出那种东西，而不只是写她那本关于我{i}最初{/i}十个学生的怪日记。

lines.en: : So, about us fucking-
lines.zh: : 那么，关于我们上床——

lines.en: : Shove it, asshole.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，混蛋。

lines.en: I appear to have failed at carrying on the conversation in a believable and normal way.
lines.zh: 我似乎没能以可信且正常的方式把对话继续下去。

lines.en: scene yukiflier12
: Tired-looking woman of familial relation to me! I have finished passing out the rectangular remains of annihilated natural wood pillars! What would you have me do next?
lines.zh: : 看起来疲惫的、与我有着血缘关系的女人！我已经把那些被歼灭的天然木柱的矩形残骸分发完毕了！接下来您要我做什么？

lines.en: : That’s all, Kaori. You don’t have to stick around anymore. I’ve got this scrub keeping me company now.
lines.zh: : 就这样了，Kaori。你不用再待着了。现在有这个废物陪我就行。

lines.en: : If I’m a scrub, how come I’m at the top of your sex list?
lines.zh: : 如果我是废物，那我怎么会排在你性爱名单的第一位？

lines.en: scene yukiflier13
: Oh, good. I say one nice thing to you and you’re already twisting it into a secret list of people I’m deciding whether or not to bone.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。我就对你说了一句好话，你马上就把它扭曲成一份我在决定要不要上的人的秘密名单。

lines.en: : Friend! If I had known your body would be in the same location as mine, I would have contacted you through my communication cube!
lines.zh: : 朋友！如果我早知道你的身体会和我的身体处在同一个位置，我就会通过我的通讯立方体联络你了！

lines.en: : I could have sworn I’d heard you say “cell phone” before.
lines.zh: : 我明明记得听你说过「手机」的。

lines.en: : You’re not...getting {i}worse{/i} at talking...are you, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你……说话没有……越来越{i}糟{/i}吧，Kaori？

lines.en: scene yukiflier14
: Friend has too many {i}other{/i} friends to make regular contact with me, so I have been taking it upon myself to do the studying of human vocabulary as my own person! Without his help!
lines.zh: : 朋友有太多{i}别的{/i}朋友，没法定期与我联系，所以我便主动承担起，以我自己的身份去学习人类词汇这件事！不需要他的帮助！

lines.en: : To speak is to communicate! And to square is to cube! I am learning!
lines.zh: : 说话即是交流！而平方即是立方！我在学习中！

lines.en: : Kaori, are you sure it was okay for you to be released from the hospital?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你真的确定你出院没问题吗？

lines.en: scene yukiflier15
: There are some things that juice can not cure, Yukiburger! I shan’t return to the jungle of uncomfortable beds and fluorescent brightness tubes!
lines.zh: : 有些东西是果汁治不好的，Yukiburger！我绝不会回到那片由不舒服的床和荧光亮度管组成的丛林里去！

lines.en: : Yukiburger?
lines.zh: : Yukiburger？

lines.en: : She added the burger part to my name earlier today. I have no idea why. And she gets mad any time I try to tell her to take it out.
lines.zh: : 她今天早些时候在我名字后面加了 burger 这部分。我完全不知道为什么。而且我每次让她去掉，她都会生气。

lines.en: : Yukiburger! Are you confident that I can depart? Are all of the trees dead?
lines.zh: : Yukiburger！你确定我可以离开了吗？所有的树都死了吗？

lines.en: : Yup. All dead, Kaori. Thanks for helping out.
lines.zh: : 对。全死了，Kaori。谢谢你帮忙。

lines.en: : I’ll ask Sara to like...wire you the money or however the fuck she’s been paying you.
lines.zh: : 我会让 Sara 那个……给你汇款，或者她他妈到底一直怎么付你钱的。

lines.en: scene yukiflier16
: Wires are unreliable, Yukiburger. Money is far too large to fit inside of them.
lines.zh: : 电线是不可靠的，Yukiburger。钱太大了，塞不进它们里面。

lines.en: : I will return to the Sara and collect my payment in the physical realm sometime before the end of the year.
lines.zh: : 我会在年底之前的某个时候回到 Sara 身边，在物理领域领取我的报酬。

lines.en: scene yukiflier17
: But...until then, hello!
lines.zh: : 不过……在那之前，你好！

lines.en: : Press buttons and say goodbye to me soon, Friend! I miss you very much!
lines.zh: : 按按按钮，快点跟我说再见，朋友！我非常想你！

lines.en: : Will do, Kaori. Have a good night.
lines.zh: : 会的，Kaori。祝你今晚愉快。

lines.en: scene yukiflier18
Kaori runs off and disappears into some alleyway, probably on the hunt for more chickens or...other animals or something.
lines.zh: Kaori 跑开，消失在某条小巷里，大概是去追更多的鸡或者……别的什么动物。

lines.en: I don’t see much point in trying to figure out what she’s doing in her spare time.
lines.zh: 我觉得去琢磨她业余时间在干什么没什么意义。

lines.en: : You know, it’s starting to make sense why you decided against telling me my niece was still alive.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我开始理解你为什么当初决定不告诉我我侄女还活着了。

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s just say that I was doing this for your own good and that it wasn’t just something that completely slipped my mind.
lines.zh: : 行。我们就当我是为了你好，而不是完全把这事忘到脑后了。

lines.en: scene yukiflier19

: For real, though. Is she like...{i}okay{/i} to function in the real world? Cause I ain’t one to really talk when it comes to shit like that, but I feel like even {i}I’ve{/i} got a leg up compared to her.
lines.zh: : 说真的。她……在现实世界里能{i}正常{/i}生活吗？我知道这种事我没资格说别人，但我觉得连{i}我都{/i}比她强一点。

lines.en: : She actually functions really well apart from frivolously spending roughly 90%% of her income on trying to free animals.
lines.zh: : 除了把大约 90%% 的收入随手花在放生动物上，她其实生活得很好。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she’s simultaneously holding six thousand jobs- and you’re somehow only holding {i}one{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定她同时打着六千份工——而你不知怎么只有{i}一份{/i}。

lines.en: : So maybe you should be taking pointers from her, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 所以也许你该向她取取经，Yuki？

lines.en: scene yukiflier20
: Hm. You know, when you put it like that, yeah. I guess maybe I could be taking some pointers from her?
lines.zh: : 嗯。你这么一说，是啊。也许我确实该向她取点经？

lines.en: : I...wasn’t really being serious. Kaori is an enigma and I don’t think it would be a good idea for any of us to try and live our lives the same way she lives hers.
lines.zh: : 我……刚才不是认真的。Kaori 是个谜，我觉得我们谁都别试着照她的方式过日子。

lines.en: scene yukiflier21
: I’m just glad she’s okay.
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴她没事。

lines.en: : If my daughter’s not gonna fuckin’ acknowledge my existence, I guess a niece doing it is like...the next best thing.
lines.zh: : 既然我女儿不肯他妈承认我的存在，那有个侄女愿意，大概就是……退而求其次的好事了。

lines.en: : ‘Sides, Kaori seems actually kind of excited to have someone she can call family. Even if she’s adding fucking “burger” onto the end of my name.
lines.zh: : 再说了，Kaori 看起来是真的挺高兴能有个可以称作家人的人。哪怕她非要在我的名字后面加个操蛋的「burger」。

lines.en: : Well hey, maybe one day, all {i}three{/i} of you can sit down and...do whatever it is the three of you did when you were younger.
lines.zh: : 嘿，也许有一天，你们{i}三个{/i}能坐下来……做你们小时候一起做的那些事。

lines.en: : Yeah. And maybe I’ll win the lottery and get elected prime minister of Japan as well.
lines.zh: : 是啊。也许我还会中彩票，然后当选日本首相呢。

lines.en: : Don’t feel the need to provide hope where there ain’t none, man.
lines.zh: : 别在本来就没有希望的地方硬塞希望了，老兄。

lines.en: : There’s some shit that stays broken forever once you’ve fucked it up...and no amount of glue or...tape, or...any other sticky shit can put it back together.
lines.zh: : 有些东西一旦被你搞砸了，就他妈永远坏着……再多的胶水或者……胶带，或者……别的什么黏糊糊的东西，都拼不回去了。

lines.en: : What really surprises me, though, is that Yumi doesn’t want to see her.
lines.zh: : 不过真正让我意外的是，Yumi 居然不想见她。

lines.en: : The two of them weren’t like...{i}inseparable{/i} or anything like that back then, but she’s one of the few people I’ve actually seen who was able to make her smile.
lines.zh: : 她们俩那时候也算不上{i}形影不离{/i}什么的，但她是我见过的为数不多能让她笑的人之一。

lines.en: : ...heh. She had a real cute smile back then, too. The kind where there’d be like, missing teeth and shit. But in a “kid” sort of way. Not like a...gross sort of way.
lines.zh: : ……呵。她那时候笑起来也真的可爱。就是那种……缺了几颗牙的。不过是「小孩子」那种缺法。不是那种……恶心的缺法。

lines.en: : You have such a way with words sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你有时候真会说话。

lines.en: scene yukiflier22
: Right, right. Which is exactly why you had such an issue with what I decided to put on all of our fuckin’ fliers.
lines.zh: : 对，对。所以你才对我决定印在所有那些操蛋传单上的话有那么大意见。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, aren’t you supposed to be passing those out?
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你是不是该去发传单了？

lines.en: : What, am I not allowed to take a fuckin’ break to hang out with the dude at the top of my secret sex list?
lines.zh: : 怎么，我不可以他妈休息一下，陪陪排在我秘密性爱名单第一位那个男人吗？

lines.en: : I {i}knew{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 我就{i}知道{/i}。

lines.en: : It was a joke, asshole.
lines.zh: : 那是玩笑，混蛋。

lines.en: : I don’t care if you’re Yumi’s new dad or...sugar daddy or whatever the fuck you are-
lines.zh: : 我不管你是 Yumi 的新爸爸还是……糖爹还是什么操蛋身份——

lines.en: : I believe it’s pronounced “teacher.”
lines.zh: : 我想这个词的发音是「老师」。

lines.en: : Sure, let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 行，就这么叫吧。

lines.en: : What I’m sayin’ is I don’t care what your role is. I’m just glad I’ve got someone like you to hang around who actually feels like a decently good person.
lines.zh: : 我要说的是，我不在乎你是什么角色。我只是很高兴身边能有个像你这样、感觉确实像个还不错的人的人。

lines.en: : That shit’s hard to come by.
lines.zh: : 这种人可难找。

lines.en: : I feel like you are, once again, gravely misinterpreting the kind of person I am.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你又一次严重误解了我是什么样的人。

lines.en: : Am I?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely. And this isn’t me just being a self-loathing piece of shit again- that’s what inner monologues are for.
lines.zh: : 绝对是。而且这回我不是又在自我厌弃——那是留给内心独白用的。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Right.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。对。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is that you can’t really judge a person by just...how they act around you. You need to think about what’s underneath the surface as well.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你不能只凭……一个人怎么对你来判断他。你也得想想表面之下的东西。

lines.en: : You barely know me. Have I been mostly kind to you? Sure. But what about how I treat other people?
lines.zh: : 你几乎不了解我。我对你大部分时候还算和善？是的。可我怎么对待别人呢？

lines.en: : What about how I treat Yumi?
lines.zh: : 我怎么对待 Yumi 呢？

lines.en: : You mean when you’re paying her phone bill and taking her job hunting? Yeah, you sound like a real douche.
lines.zh: : 你是说你替她付电话费、带她去求职的时候？是啊，听起来你可真是个混球。

lines.en: : No, Yuki...that’s not what I mean.
lines.zh: : 不是，Yuki……我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Then...you mean like when you’re boning her?
lines.zh: : 那……你是说你操她的时候？

lines.en: : You know what? I feel like getting into a philosophical debate right now probably isn’t the best thing for either one of us.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我觉得现在陷入一场哲学辩论，对我们俩大概都不是什么好事。

lines.en: : Just know that I’m not as great as you think I am.
lines.zh: : 你只要知道，我没有你想的那么好。

lines.en: : Oh, I don’t think you’re great at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，我可一点都不觉得你好。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ve done plenty of shit that you regret- but we’ve all got stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 我敢说你干过不少让自己后悔的事——但这种事谁没有。

lines.en: : You think I look back on all of the mistakes I’ve made and just shrug them off because I’m like...above them now or something? Course not.
lines.zh: : 你以为我回头看自己犯过的所有错，就因为他妈的现在已经超脱了而耸耸肩？当然不是。

lines.en: : I think I’m the fuckin’ scum of the earth. And I’m sure you feel the same way about yourself most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己是这地球上的败类。而且我敢说你大多数时候对自己也是这么想的。

lines.en: : But those thoughts are our own, man. You’ve gotta look at shit from the outside.
lines.zh: : 可那些想法是我们自己的，老兄。你得从外面看这些事。

lines.en: : You obviously don’t think I’m fucking Satan. If you did, you wouldn’t be helping me out all the fuckin’ time.
lines.zh: : 你显然不觉得我是操蛋的撒旦。要是你觉得，你就不会一直他妈帮我了。

lines.en: : So I can think whatever the fuck I want about you and you can’t do shit about it.
lines.zh: : 所以我想怎么看你都行，你拿我没办法。

lines.en: : We can hate ourselves as much as we want inside of our heads, but until we go out there and show {i}every single person in the fucking world{/i} that we’re against them-
lines.zh: : 我们在脑子里想怎么恨自己都行，但只要我们没走出去、向{i}这操蛋的世界上的每一个人{/i}表明我们与他们对立——

lines.en: : There are going to be some people who are just...on our side for no reason whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 总会有一些人毫无理由地……站在我们这边。

lines.en: : What? I’m older and more experienced than you. Don’t tell me you’re surprised to hear some words of wisdom out of me?
lines.zh: : 怎么？我比你年长，也比你更有阅历。别告诉我你听到我说出几句至理名言很意外？

lines.en: : Now, help me figure out what to do with the rest of these fliers. And don’t suggest that I just throw them out or whatever. The more customers Sakaki-bar-a gets, the more I get paid.
lines.zh: : 现在，帮我想想剩下的传单怎么办。别建议我直接扔掉什么的。Sakaki-bar-a 的客人越多，我拿的钱越多。

lines.en: : Can we just go back to calling it “the bar” please? I get irrationally angry each time I remember the real name.
lines.zh: : 我们能继续叫它「酒吧」吗？每次想起那个真名字，我都会莫名其妙地生气。

lines.en: : We can do whatever the fuck you want as soon as we finish handin’ these out.
lines.zh: : 等我们把这些发完，你想他妈干什么都行。

lines.en: : Here-
scene black
Yuki hands me roughly half of her stack of fliers and the two of us set off in opposite directions to...distribute them, I guess.
lines.zh: Yuki 把她那一摞传单里的大约一半递给我，然后我们俩朝相反的方向出发，去……分发它们，我猜。

lines.en: I don’t really know how I allowed myself to get roped into this, but it is what it is.
lines.zh: 我真不知道自己怎么就被拉进这事儿了，但事已至此。

lines.en: It’ll make Yuki happy-ish, and I’d be lying if I said I didn’t want to at least {i}try{/i} helping Sara after all of the free drinks (And blowjobs) she’s given me.
lines.zh: 这会让 Yuki 挺高兴的，而且要是说我不想在 Sara 给了我那么多免费酒（和口交）之后至少{i}试着{/i}帮帮她，那我是在撒谎。

lines.en: I do my best to hand them out to people, but “my best” only survives for a matter of minutes before being brutally murdered in the form of me stashing my entire pile in a nearby shoe store.
lines.zh: 我尽力把传单发给路人，但「我的尽力」只活了几分钟，就被我以把整摞塞进附近一家鞋店的形式残忍谋杀了。

lines.en: But hey, my job was to get rid of all of my fliers without throwing them away, and that is precisely what I did.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，我的工作是在不扔掉的前提下处理掉所有传单，而我正是这么做的。

lines.en: I send Yuki a text to figure out where she is and whether or not she wants to continue hanging out after she’s done with “work.”
lines.zh: 我给 Yuki 发了条短信，问她在哪儿，以及她「下班」后还想不想继续待在一起。

lines.en: Fortunately, she also found a shoe store to offload her fliers in, and the two of us reconvene at our original meeting spot and decide to head to a nearby convenience store for dinner.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，她也找了家鞋店把传单卸了，于是我们俩在最初的碰面地点重新会合，决定去附近的便利店吃晚饭。
